# Pocket Scribe

> A personal finance tracker for managing books, transactions, transfers, and analyzing spending trends across multiple accounts and members.

Pocket Scribe helps users record income, expenses, and transfers across multiple books and accounts, visualize financial trends, and drill down into category, account, or member breakdowns.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Dashboard with balance overview, transaction history, and holiday countdown.
- [Analysis](/analysis): Charts and breakdowns for income, expenses, and financial trends over time.
- [Sign In](/auth): Authentication page for accessing the app.
